name: Reform Technology Inc.
summary: Reform Technology Inc. operates as an online retail platform specializing in a comprehensive selection of residential equipment and fittings. Their broad product portfolio encompasses various home essentials, including built-in cooking appliances such as gas stoves, IH heaters, and ovens, alongside range hoods. The company also provides vital bathroom and kitchen fixtures like dishwashers, water heaters, toilets, bidet seats, a variety of faucets, washbasins, and vanity units. Additional offerings feature cupboards, bathroom and gas clothes dryers, delivery boxes, and ventilation systems. Established in 1998, the firm is based in Tokyo, Japan.
